Title: Why Groin Odor Gets Worse Every Summer

Description:
Groin odor, if it gets worse every summer no matter how much you shower, pay attention — that's usually not a hygiene problem. Skin folds trap heat and moisture, and bacteria breaking down sweat and oil creates the odor.

Tight underwear and not drying the area fully both make it worse. If redness or flaking shows up too, it could be jock itch rather than just sweat.

Watch to find out what actually helps.
